sections.name: summary
sections.value: Ordering is TDD-first inside each feature (Hybrid strategy: TDD for probe/at-risk/nudge/commit logic on fake ports; lightweight for guidance, wiring, docs). Fakes only in CI; the live-daemon replay is a local manual verification task. Repo guardrails: never git add -A; explicit pathspecs; HARNESS_NO_TELEMETRY=1 prefix + timeout 30 git commit --no-verify for own commits; never link global harness; never touch government/, the-flow files, refs/harness-telemetry/*. 073 surface additive-only.

value.title: Define SocketProbePort (adapters/net/) + fake; TDD the classification of connected/denied/refused/absent from injected error codes; add the resolver that maps trace2 config to unconfigured/file/af_unix targets.
Implement the node:net real adapter (bounded timeout, destroy-on-settle, never sends). Unit-test only the pure parts; the adapter itself is exercised in local manual verification, not CI.

TDD the ingress-blocked verdict into the collector health read (health.ts additive): denied+file-exists -> warning; markers explain, never decide (markers+connected -> no warning); wire doctor rendering, warn-never-block.
TDD at-risk enumeration: unattributed commits on branch within bounded window via git port; honest wording; empty-under-blocked -> unproven. Wire into doctor output.
Fix capture-liveness gating: no green when capture disabled; test on default install asserts non-healthy verdict; own review attention per standing ruling (a verdict change, not a wording change).

TDD harness commit verb: probe-first branch logic per ac-0005 (reachable -> plain commit + bounded note-verify; blocked -> GIT_TRACE2_EVENT buffer under the gitignored harness temp dir + degraded envelope naming nudge). Staging is EXPLICIT PATHSPECS ONLY (no --all flag in v1; the buffer path must be unstageable by location). execFile git, no shell. Port of the proven commit.mjs prototype, corrected per validation finding 1.

AFTER spike tk-000b: TDD harness doctor telemetry-nudge per ac-0006 — rotate -> replay whole segment (node:net; port of relay.mjs prototype) -> all-confirm-delete / partial-retain (no partial rewrite, no auto re-replay in v1) -> honest counts -> graceful no-op paths.

AFTER spike tk-000b: wire detection into doctor + checks per ac-0007 (read-only: detect unattributed commits, name the nudge command in next_action; no mutation from bare doctor/checks). Service-level tests with fakes: detection present, mutation absent.

Ship guidance: harness instructions commit page (two safe shapes + why); point doctor warning and verify-miss message at it; AGENTS.md managed block injected/refreshed idempotently through the existing guidance seam; doctor warns when block absent.
Docs: sandbox-attribution section in docs/how/gitai-collector.md (+ nudge/commit coverage), regenerate manifest if needed; check:docs green, lint at baseline.

SPIKE — gates tk-0007/tk-0008 nudge semantics (run before them; local, never CI): using a REPEATABLE fixture — fresh temp repo, missing-note commits manufactured by committing with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT pointed at a file (the proven repro; no dependency on any pre-existing repo or commits) — establish against the live daemon: (a) replay recovers a buffered commit, (b) duplicate-replay behavior (double notes? corruption? idempotent?), (c) staleness/window limits. Record outcomes in the execution log; nudge retry defaults and U-1/U-2 wording are finalized from these results.
Dependency + surface audit: no new production deps, no CI test touching daemon/socket/network/sandbox, 073 surface additive-only; run just checks at baseline.
